asset_duplicate: This asset is already on the board.
toast_not_saved: Couldn't save settings. They apply until the app is closed.
status_ticker_suspect: This ticker may not be listed.
reason_hidden: Prices resume when you come back to the app
reason_exchange_error: Exchange error {code}. Check that the ticker is listed.
wake_unsupported: This browser can't keep the screen on. Check HTTPS and browser support.
wake_pending: Asking to keep the screen on…
wake_waiting: Keeping the screen on resumes when you come back to the app.
wake_released_system: The system stopped keeping the screen on. Check its settings and try again.
wake_released: Keeping the screen on stopped. Try again.
wake_active: Keeping the screen on. The system can still turn it off.
wake_failed: Couldn't keep the screen on ({name}). Check Low Power Mode, battery and permissions.
help_settings_body: Tap the screen once and the settings button appears in the bottom-right corner; it goes away after five seconds untouched. The first tap only brings the button up, so tap the button once it shows. On a keyboard, Tab brings it up.
help_status_body: The small dot in the bottom-left corner is the connection. Tap it (or hover over it with a mouse) for details.
help_status_warn: Connecting, delayed, or needs a look
help_status_bad: Offline, or an error from the exchange
help_assets_body: Each asset added gets a card in the list. Drag the handle on the right to reorder, and tap the bin to delete (the message at the bottom can undo it). To show another coin, add it and delete the old one. With two or more assets, the screen is divided into cells of one size.
help_reading_body: 1D is against the previous day's close (Upbit), 24H the change over 24 hours (Binance), and PERP Binance USDT perpetual futures. When a price changes, only the digits that changed roll over, and the bigger the move, the deeper the color.
help_keep_body: Add it to the home screen and open it like an app: it runs full screen, and keeping the screen on works best that way (Safari's Share button, then Add to Home Screen). Keep it charging, and turn Low Power Mode off.
